build_note: Built from the pinned pure-Python sdist (PyPI has no wheel) on Debian bookworm Python 3.11 with pinned setuptools; the installed mindsdb_sql_parser and sly packages are checked byte-identical to the sdist.
dependencies_note: No runtime dependencies: the SLY 0.5 lexer/LALR library is vendored in the same distribution (top-level sly package) and is traced with the parser. The fuzz entry point is an external one-file Python bridge, not Atheris.
parser_family: mindsdb_sql_parser SQL grammar (mindsdb_sql_parser/lexer.py and parser.py) on the SLY lexer/LALR engine; independent of sqlparse, sqlglot, sqlfluff, mo-sql-parsing, libpg_query and sqlparser-rs. Successor of the mindsdb_sql package's parser (mindsdb-sql is recorded as its predecessor name and excluded)
dialect: MindsDB SQL dialect (mindsdb_sql_parser.parse_sql default; the only dialect of 0.13.8)
api: mindsdb_sql_parser.parse_sql(local SQL text decoded from UTF-8 bytes) -> AST statement object (Select, Insert, ...); the harness walks Select targets, from_table Join/Identifier tree, where, group_by, order_by, Function and Constant nodes, and Insert table, columns and values
fuzz_engine: external one-file Python bridge for AFL++ and generator replay
coverage: Python line tracing of the mindsdb_sql_parser package and its vendored SLY library during valid-control replay
scope: One SQL statement from local text via mindsdb_sql_parser.parse_sql (parse_sql returns a single statement object; both controls hold one statement); valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls only, each matching the hand-written oracle summary. Numeric constants are Python int/float values converted to text, which equals the source text for these controls. MindsDB-specific statements and to_string rendering are untested.
